definition: Content documents are Git regular blobs (100644) excluding archive copies and curated views; symlinks (120000) are aliases and do NOT count as independent untranslated documents.
limitations: This is a mode/SHA and filename-level audit, not a full semantic-duplicate detector.
An English synopsis is not a full translation. Historical 87 reports and ten thesis files remain Serbian.
Twenty earlier legacy/flat links to active root SR files were mistakenly counted as untranslated documents in v1; corrected here without changing the v1 archival blob.
Frozen studies, result archives, scientific code and the chronological research handoff are unchanged.
Non-_SR Serbian text may still exist elsewhere, including historical entries in PHD_PROGRESS.md.
